_comment: The whole Age is seen in grey, every frame and everywhere in it (Jonah, 2026-10-12): drained completely to
its own brightness, the GUI left in colour. Ephemeris's monochrome filter. Strange, whole at one step.
Never bought where the book set `air.drained`.
Drawn at a third of the others' weight (Jonah, 2026-10-21): it was in nearly every collapsing Age, and a world
without colour is the strangest thing instability does.
